subject: Best Daily Window (MM vs. WW) for 24-Hour Movement Guidelines in GGIR

messages.author: 23ba096e0ff96c71
messages.subject: Best Daily Window (MM vs. WW) for 24-Hour Movement Guidelines in GGIR
parts:
Hi everyone,

I’m working on a study looking at 24-hour movement behaviors (physical activity, sleep, and screen time) and using GGIR to analyze accelerometer data. I’ve noticed that GGIR provides two options for daily windows: midnight-to-midnight (MM) and wake-up-to-wake-up (WW).

For my analysis, is it correct to use MM for sleep and WW for physical activity, or should I stick to a single daily window for both? I want to ensure I’m following the 24-hour movement guidelines properly.

Any advice would be really helpful! Thanks in advance!

Best,
J.P. Espinoza

Dear Juan,

Unfortunately, I cannot provide free advice on how to do your research. I only reply to questions in this group that relate to the clarity or correctness of GGIR. Maybe other members of the group want to chip in and share their thoughts.
I want to ensure I’m following the 24-hour movement guidelines properly.

That would be impossible because 24-hour movement guidelines do not come with specific guidelines on how to quantify adherence. Please contact these PA guideline committees and ask them for guidance on how to quantify their guidelines.

Thanks,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
